title: Cozmo stack source-fidelity manifest
about: One record per behaviour-affecting decision, or tightly bound group of decisions, in the hand-written
production code of cozmo-stack. Platform plumbing that cannot change what the robot does (logging,
collection choices, string formatting, file layout) is not recorded.
The manifest, not the prose documents, is the authoritative statement of what rests on primary source.
re-analysis/tools/fidelity.py validates it and regenerates FIDELITY_GAPS.md from it.
authority_order: the decompiled Unity C# (unity/scripts/csharp) and managed assemblies
the shipped Wwise banks, their .txt definition files, SoundbanksInfo.xml and PluginInfo.xml
the shipped OBB assets, configuration and animation data
CLAD / message schemas and the code generated from them
captures taken from the original app (re-analysis/captures)
existing reverse-engineering notes, only after checking them against the primary evidence above

statuses.EXACT_SOURCE: Read from primary source and reproduced. The record names the address, asset or schema it was read from.
statuses.EQUIVALENT_IMPLEMENTATION: The native behaviour is known from primary source; this stack reaches the same observable effect by a different mechanism, and the record names the difference.
statuses.RECOVERABLE_GAP: A behaviour-affecting decision whose answer plausibly exists in primary source that has not been read, or has been read too shallowly to settle it. Blocks source-completeness on a live path.
statuses.COMPATIBILITY_POLICY: A deliberate choice of this stack on a path that does not claim to be the engine's: offline tools, the test harness, PC-side plumbing, or a stand-in the operator has to ask for.
statuses.HARDWARE_ONLY: No shipped artifact can settle it; only a robot, or a recording of the stock app, can.
statuses.BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: The answer lies in third-party code or data that is not in the package (Omron OKAO, the Wwise runtime DSP, the Acapela text-to-speech engine).

gate.rule: A subsystem may assert source_complete only when it holds no RECOVERABLE_GAP with live_path true.

field_notes.location: repository-relative path, optionally with :line, of the code the record is about
field_notes.effect: what a listener, viewer or the robot would observe if this decision were wrong
field_notes.provenance: what the current implementation actually rests on
field_notes.authority: the best available original evidence for this decision
field_notes.evidence: concrete references: native addresses, asset paths, bank object ids, capture files
field_notes.unresolved: what is still not established; empty string when nothing is
field_notes.hardware_required: whether a robot is genuinely needed to settle it
field_notes.live_path: whether the decision is reached on a normal run against a robot
field_notes.test: the regression that would fail if the recovered behaviour were undone

records.title: Whether cozmo_singing_note_off also stops the voice it is attached to
records.effect: a held note is cut the instant it is released, or plays out the looping iteration it is in
records.provenance: the renderer ends a looping note by finishing its current iteration, which is the break-on-note-off rule the note layer's bit vector asks for
records.authority: the shipped bank: this modulator alone of the eleven sets property 15, to the integer 2. The two readings that fit the numbering argued from the data agree on what a listener hears - under either one the voice ends when the note is released, which is also what the note layer's break-on-note-off bit asks for
evidence: no other modulator in any bank sets property 15
records.unresolved: the name of modulator property 15 and the enumeration of its values, which live in the Wwise SDK; no Wwise runtime or header ships in the APK

records.title: The shape a Wwise LFO produces between its extremes
records.effect: with a cube being shaken, the vibrato sharpens and flattens, or only sharpens, and by a different amount at each instant
records.provenance: a sine over 0 to 1, chosen because both bindings in the banks define their curves over exactly 0 to 1 and neither defines anything below 0
records.authority: the Wwise runtime, which does not ship in the APK (no AkSoundEngine, CAk* or Wwise strings occur in any .so). The bank settles the frequency, the attack, the pulse width and the range the curve maps the output onto; it cannot settle the waveform Wwise draws
evidence: Cozmo.bnk object 528935089 sets no waveform property
its binding curve spans 0 to 1 exactly
records.unresolved: whether the output is unipolar or bipolar, and the exact waveform. Unreachable on any live path while the depth is 0, which it is until the cube-shake stream exists (M9-017)
